DIV8.HEAD: § 1005.11 Procedures for resolving errors.
DIV8.P: (a) Definition of error—(1) Types of transfers covered. The term error means an unauthorized electronic fund transfer and includes:
(i) A computational or bookkeeping error made by the financial institution relating to a transfer.
(2) Types of inquiries not covered. The term error does not include a routine balance inquiry.
(b) Notice of error from consumer. A notice of error is valid when received by the institution.
(c) Time limits and extended time limits. A financial institution shall investigate promptly.
(1) The financial institution shall complete its investigation within ten (10) business days of receiving the notice of error.

DIV8.HEAD: § 1005.13 Administrative enforcement; record retention.
DIV8.P: (a) Enforcement by Federal agencies. Compliance with this part is enforced in accordance with section 918 of the Act.
(b) Record retention. Any person subject to this part shall retain evidence of compliance for a period of not less than two years.

DIV9.HEAD: Supplement I to Part 1005—Official Interpretations
DIV9.P: 1. Ten-day period. The 10-day period for investigation applies to the initial determination of whether an error occurred.
1. Example. A financial institution that completes its investigation on the ninth business day complies with this paragraph.
